2026-11-18 review: npm audit identifies this path only under dev dependency tooling (Jest/Vercel), not deployed production dependencies. GHSA-fc5q-39xc-vjpf/CVE-2026-112366 is a ReDoS via attacker-controlled repeated extglob patterns; official npm latest is 4.0.7, no fixed release at review time. No customer-supplied glob input is used in this CI-only path. Temporary dev-tooling risk acceptance, not a vulnerability fix; revisit immediately on a patched release, deployment scope change, or before 2026-12-02. Never approve production exposure.
